title: feat(nm2oricyccy): cyclic next/prev lex-smallest det orientation of 1-in 2-out at t+1 on two-axis opposite y-probes: reverse HOLD, face fail
science: opposite y-probes, cyclic lex-SMALLEST orientation: reverse=HOLD. With #7456 (lex-largest, reverse=fail) this is the second, sign-reversed instance of the same tie-break artifact - here it is SMALLEST that manufactures the HOLD, showing neither convention is privileged.
